title: 第一卷 第25章 五人第一卷 第26章 才艺
lines: 美人在怀，林风眠却冷汗涔涔，连忙推开夏云溪。
“云溪，你冷静一点！”
夏云溪回过神来，这才发现林风眠突破了，不由又惊又喜。
“师兄你突破了？”
林风眠看着比自己还激动的夏云溪，不由一阵后怕。
“云溪，你为什么不阻止我？”
夏云溪脸色微红，害羞道：“没事的，师兄……我已经筑基了。”
林风眠愣住了，错愕道：“你已经筑基了？”
夏云溪嗯了一声，轻声道：“今天刚突破的。”
林风眠不由目瞪口呆，这丫头居然在被自己吸收修为的情况下，突破了筑基？
果然，人与人之间的差距，有时候比人和狗之间还大！
夏云溪继续道：“师尊答应过我，如果我突破就让我跟着一起下山。”
“如无意外，明日考核我也是考官之一，会助师兄一臂之力的！”
闻言，林风眠哪里还不知道她突破是为了帮自己下山？
“傻丫头，你何至于此？”
夏云溪俏脸微红，一眨不眨看着他，声音细微却异常坚定。
“因为我喜欢师兄啊！”
林风眠心都要化了，脱口而出道：“云溪，你跟我一起逃吧。”
之前他就有这个想法，只是担心自己没办法突破，害了夏云溪。
如今两人既然都突破了，林风眠也就再无一丝顾忌了！
夏云溪啊了一声，小脸上满是错愕。
“师兄你说什么？”
“我说，到时候你跟我一起逃吧！”
林风眠认真看着她，忐忑道：“你愿意吗？”
夏云溪眼中泪水不断滑落，连连点头，哽咽道：“愿意，我愿意！”
林风眠轻轻擦去她脸上的泪水，温柔道：“傻丫头，别哭了！”
夏云溪手忙脚乱地擦着泪水，笑中带泪道：“我只是高兴！”
林风眠心疼地看着这丫头，动情地将她抱入怀中。
虽然抱着一丝不挂的绝美少女，但他心中却没有半分情欲。
夏云溪也紧紧抱着他，泪水止都止不住。
虽然前路未知，甚至是一片黑暗，但她却满心欢喜。
哪怕是跟林风眠一起死在外面，夏云溪也无怨无悔。
content_en:
With the beauty in his arms, Lin Fengmian was sweating and quickly pushed Xia Yunxi away.
"Yunxi, calm down!"
Xia Yunxi came back to her senses and realized that Lin Fengmian had made a breakthrough. She couldn't help being surprised and happy.
"Senior brother, have you made a breakthrough?"
Lin Fengmian looked at Xia Yunxi, who was even more excited than himself, and couldn't help but feel scared.
"Yunxi, why don't you stop me?"
Xia Yunxi's face turned red and she said shyly, "It's okay, senior brother... I have already established the foundation."
Lin Fengmian was stunned and asked in astonishment: "Have you already established the foundation?"
Xia Yunxi hummed and said softly: "I just made a breakthrough today."
Lin Fengmian couldn't help but be stunned. This girl actually broke through the foundation building while being absorbed by him?
Sure enough, the gap between people is sometimes bigger than that between people and dogs!
Xia Yunxi continued: "Master promised me that if I break through, let me follow him down the mountain."
"If nothing unexpected happens, I will be one of the examiners in tomorrow's assessment and will help my senior brother!"
Hearing this, Lin Fengmian didn't know that her breakthrough was to help him get down the mountain?
"Silly girl, why are you doing this?"
Xia Yunxi's pretty face was slightly red, and she looked at him without blinking, her voice was subtle but extremely firm.
"Because I like senior brother!"
Lin Fengmian's heart almost melted and he blurted out: "Yunxi, you can escape with me."
He had this idea before, but he was worried that he would not be able to break through and harm Xia Yunxi.
Now that both of them have broken through, Lin Fengmian no longer has any scruples!
Xia Yunxi groaned, his little face full of astonishment.
"Senior brother, what did you say?"
"I said, when the time comes, you can run away with me!"
Lin Fengmian looked at her seriously and said anxiously: "Are you willing?"
Tears kept falling from Xia Yunxi's eyes, she nodded repeatedly and choked with sobs: "Yes, I do!"
Lin Fengmian gently wiped the tears from her face and said gently: "Silly girl, stop crying!"
Xia Yunxi hurriedly wiped her tears and said with tears in her smile: "I'm just happy!"
Lin Fengmian looked at the girl with distress and held her in his arms emotionally.
Although he was holding the naked and beautiful girl, he didn't have any lust in his heart.
Xia Yunxi also hugged him tightly and couldn't stop crying.
Although the road ahead was unknown and even dark, she was filled with joy.
Even if she died outside with Lin Fengmian, Xia Yunxi had no regrets.
